challenge.better_approach: Compiling straight from the current traces would be smaller but cannot generalize: the features are not recorded. Recording provides first is the smallest honest step.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a floor of per-constraint kill rules over provides is the right shape to compile into: the engine's own _satisfies is exactly that shape, so the floor reuses it; whether the traces the first compile should learn from are the engine runs at all, or the host backfill's kills, is Q#97, his to settle.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/machines/learning_block/engine.py (_satisfies is the judging predicate the floor replays); probes/engine_trace_corpus.py (the cast trigger); the intentions_model_compiler is a different compile (charters to a model), a name neighbour, not prior art.
challenge.real_collision: none found: read the congruency lab's learning_block charter and the parent's falsifier, which this child implements one clause of

answers.falsifier: (1) over a scratch trace root holding >=5 engine runs of one block with distinct inputs, compile_floor emits a floor, and apply_floor reproduces every traced run's outcome (winner name or escalation target) from that run's recorded input and candidates; (2) two compiles over the same corpus write byte-identical floors, and compile.py imports no inference client; (3) compile_floor refuses, naming every lack in one refusal, a corpus with fewer than 5 runs of distinct input and a corpus whose candidates carry no provides; a fixture shaped like the live librarian-ask corpus as measured 2026-11-13 is refused on both; (4) a run_block over a fixture spec writes each candidate's provides into candidates_log, and the existing engine teeth in test_learning_block.py stay green
answers.from_idea: none, because the parent ticket CairnCommons/tickets/d6cacb63868b-learning-block-engine-track.json names this child and its cast condition
answers.how: D1: run_block's candidates_log keeps each candidate's provides. D2: compile.py's compile_floor(block, root=None) reads the block's training engine_run traces, refuses (DoorRefused, every lack) fewer than 5 runs of distinct input or any candidate without provides, and otherwise emits a floor of per-constraint kill rules over provides keys plus the decide-or-escalate order; apply_floor(floor, payload, candidates) evaluates it. The floor berths in instance-space at ~/.cairn/devices/learning_block/0/floors/<block>.json. D3: the proof, over a scratch trace root. Built red-first; held at BUILDME by Q#97 (which corpus the first compile learns from).
answers.traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver is spent on the novel: a settled block decision compiles to code instead of re-running inference) and Law 8 (a compile that memorizes must not pass for one that learned).
answers.what: A compile step reads one block's recorded engine runs and emits a deterministic floor that reproduces their decisions without inference, refusing a corpus that cannot teach it.

bullets.text: cast 2026-11-13 on the orchestrator's word; the corpus measurement rides measured, and Q#97 holds the build at BUILDME
